description: This file defines the UpDownImage class, a Swing JPanel component used for rendering visual representations of engine event reports, particularly engine signal transitions like up/down times, revolutions, and TDC labels. It handles drawing engine cycle lines, scale lines, and interactive tooltip updates, integrating with other components like EngineReport and RevolutionLog.

classes.name: UpDownImage
classes.description: A Swing JPanel component responsible for rendering engine signal events, revolutions, and time scale for a specific engine report and signal channel. Supports mouse interaction for tooltip display and dynamic updating.

methods.name: setSignalBody
methods.description: Sets the color used to fill the signal body rectangle representing signal duration.

methods.name: setSignalBorder
methods.description: Sets the color used for the border lines around the signal rectangle.

methods.name: setToolTip
methods.description: Updates the tooltip text to show channel and pin information.

methods.name: setZoomProvider
methods.description: Placeholder method to set zooming behavior, currently empty.

methods.name: createTranslator
methods.description: Creates a TimeAxisTranslator instance that maps engine report times to screen coordinates.

methods.name: setWaveReport
methods.description: Updates the current engine report data and triggers repainting and propagation of dwell time into the sensor.

methods.name: propagateDwellIntoSensor
methods.description: Extracts the latest dwell duration from the report and updates the corresponding sensor value.

methods.name: paint
methods.description: Overrides Swing paint method to render engine report data, scale lines, and mouse-over information.

methods.name: drawStartOfRevolution
methods.description: Draws vertical lines indicating revolution start points based on revolution log data.

methods.name: isShowTdcLabel
methods.description: Determines whether to label TDC points; currently returns false.

methods.name: paintScaleLines
methods.description: Draws time scale lines at millisecond intervals, with scaling considerations.

methods.name: paintUpDown
methods.description: Draws visual representations of engine signal events, including durations, angles, and optional labels.

methods.name: setRevolutions
methods.description: Sets the revolution log data for rendering.

methods.name: setPhysicalPin
methods.description: Updates the physical pin label used in the tooltip.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the UpDownImage object.
